rows.Origin:
Bred by Anthony Perry (United States, 1987).
Introduced in United States by Co-Operative Rose Growers in 1989 as 'World Peace'.
rows.Bloom: Red and yellow. Fruity fragrance. 30 to 35 petals. Double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
